payload.summary: Read src/ui/round-timeline.ts, src/ui/celebration.ts, src/ui/card-el.ts and src/styles/anim.css. Three answers, and one of them is a defect the ticket did not ask about. (1) deal-slide is SAFE under any reordering: prepareCard() computes --deal-x/--deal-y from card.getBoundingClientRect() after the card is already laid out, so the flight path is derived from wherever the card actually landed. Reversing the visual order changes the target rect and the animation follows it. (2) third-card emphasis is SAFE: setRotated() adds .is-third before prepareCard runs, and the third-card-emphasis keyframes re-state rotate(90deg) translate(6px,-4px) at every stop, so the rotation survives the concurrently-applied deal-slide — .card.is-third-emphasis is declared after .card.is-dealing in app.css, so its animation shorthand wins at equal specificity. A mirrored player rotation must re-state the mirrored transform in those keyframes too or the emphasis will snap the card back to the un-mirrored angle mid-pulse. (3) NOT safe, and pre-existing: table-view.ts passes playerHand.element.getBoundingClientRect() to celebration.panda(), and celebration's centerRelativeToHost() fires the particles from that rect's CENTRE. .hand is a stretched grid item filling its whole 1fr column, so the Panda 8 burst already fires from the centre of the felt's left half rather than from the cards — today the cards sit flush LEFT of that point, and after this delta they will sit flush RIGHT of it. Same for celebration.dragon() on the banker. The anchor should be .hand-cards, which is where the winning hand physically is.
